# Nicola Mastromarino

> AI Engineer at Machine Learning Reply specializing in Generative AI, RAG architectures, LLMOps pipelines, and Cloud Native platforms.

## Key Metrics & Impact

- **-70% ops:** Operational overhead reduction through automated Cloud-Native & LLMOps pipelines.
- **+190% Token F1:** Improvement in Medical RAG Question Answering over baseline.
- **-40% hallucinations:** Reduction in LLM hallucinations via hybrid RAG & Knowledge Graph grounding.

## Featured AI Systems & Case Studies

- **Medical RAG Question Answering System:** Hybrid RAG pipeline with QLoRA fine-tuned BioMistral-7B and S1–S5 ablation study (+190% Token F1 vs baseline).
- **FactKG — Graph RAG:** Knowledge Graph-grounded RAG system for factual verification and hallucination reduction (-40% hallucinations).
- **Facial Expression Recognition:** Deep Learning computer vision pipeline ([GitHub](https://github.com/NicolaM99/facial-expression-recognition)).
